snippet.title: Cast Outs - Overview Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase #gaming #coopgames #action
snippet.description:
We're proud to be featured and trusted to open the show in the @MediaIndieExchange x @KindaFunnyGames Spring Game Showcase. 

Cast Outs is a 2 to 4 player PvE action game. Set in a reimagined London, where magic is real, and folklore walks the streets.

Your squad chains raw magic, class and ability combinations, with rogue lite power ups through fast missions / runs.

Think Left 4 Dead meets inFAMOUS, built for players who love Helldivers 2, Deep Rock Galactic, and Split Fiction. Built for friends of all skill levels across PC and console who want high action, mastery, and social fun, without live service pressure, toxicity, or constant grind.

Available to Wishlist on Steam & PlayStation 5 ✨

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3307340/Cast_Outs/ 
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016525/ 

Discord: http://discord.playcastouts.com/

All our Links: https://linktr.ee/playcastouts

Huge thanks to The MIX and Kinda Funny for trusting us to kick off the show. It was a big moment for our team and a chance to share a fresh look at Cast Outs more players. Thank you for your support!
